title: Smurf Mountain
meta_description: Smurf Mountain: 2BR condo in Redfish Village with bunk nook, pool, beach access \& family-friendly perks. Walk to Blue Mountain Beach. Sleeps up to 6.
description_expanded:
ABOUT THE HOME: This recently remodeled 2 bedroom, 2.5 bath condo, located in the Redfish Village, is a perfect retreat for the family. The complex borders the beautiful Redfish Lake and provides a boardwalk and overlook pavilion to explore the surrounding nature and soak in all of the scenery.

ABOUT THE AREA: Blue Mountain Beach is one of the 30A coastal communities that rests between Santa Rosa Beach and Grayton Beach State Park. The Blue Mountain community is known for its tranquility, many restaurants, and family atmosphere. The natural beauty of the sugar sand beaches, walking, biking trails and adventure await you.

BEACH ACCESS: Private deeded beach across street, about 3 blocks walk (has restrooms, \& shower) just east of Blue Mountain Regional public beach. There are restrooms, shower, some parking and coolers, wagons and single inflatable toys are permitted, as well as kayaks and paddle boards.

ACCOMMODATIONS:
• Bedroom 1 --1 King, ensuite
• Bedroom 2 --1 King
• Bunks 1 twin over twin bunk (in hallway)

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• Community seasonally heated pool
• Enclosed playground, yard area \& games
• Gas Grills -- Propane, community use
• Seasonal tram to beach
• Balcony with seating
• Private deeded beach
• Smart TVs in every bedroom with roku stick and YouTube TV?
• Fitness Room
• Coffee Maker -- both Keurig and Pot
• Full linen package: bedding \& bath
• Starter kit: toilet paper, paper towels, dishwasher and washing machine pods
• Fully stocked kitchen

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.

Parking Details:
- Parking Lot and 1 garage space

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
